understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; when there were multiple goals, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to count as won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifted the currently selected piece by grid-cell increments, with coordinates represented in pixels. CLICK switched control to another selectable using its displayed pixel position. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed when moving into them, while walls and boundaries could block movement, though the blocked indicator was only a heuristic and actions had to be tested. The level had a limited step budget and required careful planning of piece order and positioning.
